core: Main audience takeaway, not the slide title, a content inventory or layout instructions.
elements: Complete list of content units in reading order.
elements.intent: Message, facts, evidence or relationship this element conveys and its relevance to the slide.
elements.type: Content representation; use metric for a key figure, diagram for relationships, and asset for visual media.
layout: Spatial arrangement and reading order, e.g. 'chart left, explanation right'; not HTML or CSS.
purpose: Dominant narrative role. Use content_other for body-content roles outside the listed content categories, and other for page roles outside the listed categories.
slide_id: Slide ID from the current outline.
